reference.configuration: Contemporary 1927 carrier diagram with paired profile and deck views, used as a Langley-type conversion reference. The original caption does not name a vessel: identification is inferred from the collier hull, open truss-supported deck, paired hinged side funnels, telescopic masts and central cargo-hold/elevator arrangement. It is a simplified contemporary type diagram, not a dimensioned Langley as-fitted plan. Original Cyrillic labels and original bow-right orientation are preserved.
reference.note: Stylized class interpretation guided by catalog dimensions, armament and the linked recognition reference; not an engineering plan or exact reconstruction. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
